concerns.text: FR-001 claims the system MUST download BMRQ (Barcelona Music Reward Questionnaire) scores from the HCP 1200 Subjects Release (Music Task subset). However, no verified open HCP dataset provides BMRQ or an equivalent validated musical‑emotion trait measure. This makes the primary validation target unavailable, rendering SC-001 (correlation with BMRQ) and SC-002 (regression R² against BMRQ) impossible to evaluate. Using an ad‑hoc ‘behavioral_proxy’ without explicit construct‑validation violates the core research question and introduces a circular/tautological validation where the outcome is not independent of the predictor pipeline.
